title: Bluff
summary: BLUFF, adjective [Eng.leap, from shooting forward.]surly; blustering. BLUFF, noun A high bank, almost perpendicular, projecting into the sea; a high bank presenting a steep front. BLUFF'-BOWED, adject

inlines.v: BLUFF, adjective [Eng.leap, from shooting forward.]surly; blustering. BLUFF, noun A high bank, almost perpendicular, projecting into the sea; a high bank presenting a steep front. BLUFF'-BOWED, adjective [bluff and bow.] Having broad and flat bows. BLUFF'-HEADED, adjective [bluff and head.] Having an upright stem.
